groups.name: iqkv.platform
groups.description: Platform-wide operational settings. Must be consistent across all core services (IAM, Billing, Gateway, CMS, AI Chat).

groups.name: iqkv.tenancy
groups.description: Tenancy settings used for single-tenant mode.

groups.name: iqkv.iam
groups.description: IAM service integration used by PlatformModeGuardFilter for canonical rollout-mode verification.

groups.name: iqkv.billing
groups.description: Billing service integration used by the entitlement PlanResolver.

groups.name: iqkv.gateway
groups.description: Gateway-specific properties: audit source identifier and the paths that bypass authentication.

properties.name: iqkv.platform.rollout-mode
properties.description: Platform-wide operational mode. Must match the rollout-mode configured in the other core services. MULTI_TENANT: each signup creates a new tenant with TENANT_OWNER authority. SINGLE_TENANT: all users join a single pre-provisioned default tenant with MEMBER authority.

properties.name: iqkv.tenancy.default-tenant-key
properties.description: Default tenant key for SINGLE_TENANT mode. Must match the IAM service configuration. Format: 8-character NanoID using alphabet [a-z0-9]. Optional — when blank the gateway does not auto-inject a tenant key.

properties.name: iqkv.iam.service-url
properties.description: Base URL of the IAM service used by PlatformModeGuardFilter to verify the canonical rollout mode. Must point to the IAM management port (8081), not the main API port (80/8080).

properties.name: iqkv.billing.service-url
properties.description: Base URL of the billing service used by PlanResolver for quota enforcement.

properties.name: iqkv.billing.plan-refresh-interval
properties.description: How often plan data is refreshed, as an ISO-8601 duration string (e.g. PT10M).

properties.name: iqkv.gateway.audit-source
properties.description: Audit source identifier emitted for platform-wide event tracking. Falls back to 'web-gateway' when blank.

properties.name: iqkv.gateway.public-paths
properties.description: Path patterns (Ant-style) that bypass JWT authentication, matched by PlatformModeGuardFilter / SecurityConfig. Defaults to an empty list when unset.

values.description: Multi-tenant mode: each signup creates a new tenant.
